extension.summary: Bias lighting via WLED on your LAN
extension.description: AmbientWLED drives a GLEDOPTO GL-C-017WL-D (or any WLED) from Kodi on CoreELEC. Week 1: JSON discover, DDP fake color cycle. Capture and edge mapping come in later weeks. Does not touch HDMI, eARC, or audio paths.
extension.news: Week 1: WLED JSON + DDP + fake cycle stub
